entry.title: Read a little of your book aloud
entry.invitation: Read a little aloud from something you enjoy.
entry.summary: In the first few months, a book you want to read can become something to share: read it aloud with your baby nearby.
entry.cue: You have something you would enjoy reading and your baby is awake and comfortable.
detail: Davies and Uzodike describe early reading as a chance to hear the sounds and rhythm of language. The book does not have to be a baby book; you can read from one that interests you.
Simple picture books are another option. If a picture catches your baby’s attention, you can describe it or stay with that page.
